mentions.claim_text: He recalls seeing that the BRICS nations no longer wanted the West telling them what to do and were devising a plan, and that he first heard the phrase Red Dawn for an enemy within America.
mentions.quote: I saw an enemy Within America a red Dawn
mentions.falsify_match: An organised hostile network inside the United States exposed.
mentions.falsify_miss: None exposed. Red Dawn is a 1984 film title about a foreign invasion of America, so the image is borrowed rather than novel.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a Cold War KGB spirit over Russia and Putin rising again, hears the phrase peace and safety then sudden destruction, and sees it playing out with Iran, Syria and Turkey.
mentions.quote: peace and safety then sudden destruction
mentions.falsify_match: A declared peace followed immediately by war involving those states.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such sequence. The phrase is 1 Thessalonians 5:3 rather than a new word.

mentions.claim_text: He says a party will come to Syria's defence like a brother when Israel strikes it, and that they were less protective of Iran than of Syria despite strikes coming against Iran.
mentions.quote: like a brother coming to their aid as Israel strikes Syria
mentions.falsify_match: A third state intervening on Syria's behalf against Israeli strikes.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. The party is not named, which is the weakness.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Putin, Xi Jinping and North Korea rising together against what the United States wants to do with the dollar, and repeats that major trade wars were coming.
mentions.quote: I told you major trade wars were coming
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated Russia, China and North Korea move against the dollar.
mentions.falsify_miss: No coordinated move. The trade war half is recalled after the tariffs were already public.

mentions.claim_text: He points to Trump saying that day that the only way it works for Canada is becoming the 51st state, and offers it against what he says he saw about Canada joining America.
mentions.quote: the only way I can see it working for Canada is becoming the 51st state
mentions.falsify_match: Canada joins the United States in some formal arrangement.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He is quoting a statement made that day rather than forecasting.

mentions.claim_text: He calls the blood moon a significant sign in the heavens, says the situation between Israel and Iran is rice paper thin, and says he was shown specific targets and plans in meetings between Israel and America that he cannot detail.
mentions.quote: the Lord showed me specific targets specific things that are being planned
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable as given: he states he was shown specific targets and then withholds all of them.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail. Withheld specifics are the one form of detail that can never be checked either way.

mentions.claim_text: He says the thing he has been praying over is fixed and will come to pass and everyone will be startled, and that an antisemitic uprising will rise in America against Israel beyond the current protests.
mentions.quote: I saw an uprising in America with anti-Semitism against Israel
mentions.falsify_match: Antisemitic mobilisation in America exceeding the 2024 campus protests.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Saying a thing is already fixed removes the prayer condition he usually attaches, which makes this a firmer claim than most.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for the nation to turn around and be godly again, and for Canada, its parliament and its leadership to have a major outpouring.
mentions.quote: our nation is going to turn around and make it Godly again

mentions.claim_text: He prays that a woman he describes as manipulated by cartels rise up and act godly, and for a major move of God through Puerto Rico, South America, Brazil, Colombia and Venezuela.
mentions.quote: cartels manipulating her that she would rise up
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim as given: a petition, though the assertion that a named country's leader is manipulated by cartels is an allegation without support.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for freedom to worship as never before and a window in which the fire of the Holy Ghost visits all of Asia, India and Pakistan.
mentions.quote: a window of opportunity that the fire of the Holy Ghost will go
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition with no measure.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Trump striking the whip again in Europe.
mentions.quote: I see Trump striking that whip again in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: American pressure applied to European governments.
mentions.falsify_miss: None applied. The image carries no content beyond that, and pressure on Europe was already the visible policy.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has alarm bells for Israel and for Christians in Syria being brutally murdered and martyred for their faith.
mentions.quote: I have alarm bells for Israel
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a reaction to the March 2025 coastal massacres in Syria, which were already reported.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is a window now before a great shaking, and urges people not to treat Syria as too far away to act on.
mentions.quote: we have a window right now before there's great Shaking
mentions.falsify_match: A great shaking following the window.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The window has no stated end, so it cannot close.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are in a very serious time and calls for prayer for Israel and Iran, saying he does not want to keep rehashing it.
mentions.quote: we're in a very serious time
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a call to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He points to a forecast cyclone with hurricane-force winds expected to hit Texas, Oklahoma and Kansas with a major fire outbreak on the Friday, calls it weather manipulation, and takes authority over it.
mentions.quote: hurricane force winds are supposed to hit Texas and Oklahoma and Kansas
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forecast of his: he is reading a published weather forecast and praying against it. The 14 March 2025 storm did produce hurricane-force gusts and major wildfires across those states.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not his claim. Recorded because weather manipulation is the interpretation he adds to a National Weather Service forecast.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the Canadian prime minister being replaced by a new prime minister, and that a new shift and direction over Canada is what the Lord was showing that day, while noting he does not know whether the replacement has already happened.
mentions.quote: I've seen him being replaced with a new prime minister over Canada
mentions.falsify_match: A change of Canadian prime minister.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Note the change had already occurred: Mark Carney was sworn in on 14 March 2025, the day before this was recorded, and he says himself he does not know whether it has happened.

mentions.claim_text: Declarative prayer calling revival over America, Europe, Africa, South America and Asia, a stirring in South and North Korea, and the iron curtain and bondage removed.
mentions.quote: WE CALL FORTH THE BONDAGE AND THE IRON CURTAIN to be removed
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: declarative intercession over continents.
